description: Relays the user’s answer to the question Capital Company’s assistant asked last, in their own words, and returns what the assistant says next: another question, or a proposal for the user to confirm.

answer.description: The user’s answer, in their own words

team.description: The team the conversation is on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York
